title: Retry LLM Calls with Backoff and Jitter
signature: def call_with_retry(fn, clock, rand, max_attempts=5, base=0.5, cap=8.0)
hints: Only some errors deserve a retry: rate limits, 5xx and timeouts. A 400 will fail the same way every time.
Full jitter: sleep a uniform amount in [0, min(cap, base * 2**attempt)]. Call rand() exactly once per backoff.
If the server sent Retry-After, wait at least that long. Never sleep less than the server asked.
